newsitem.title: USA: Chicago to sell bonds for air freight facility.
newsitem.headline: Chicago to sell bonds for air freight facility.

text.p: Chicago's City Council said Thursday it plans to issue $55 million in industrial development bonds to help build a nearly 800,000 square-foot multi-purpose air freight facility at O'Hare International Airport.

CenterPoint O'Hare LLC will develop the facility for cargo-related carriers and handlers, freight forwarders, trucking companies and distribution firms, according to a release from the city's Planning and Development Department.
"This is yet another opportunity to improve our city's business climate while helping our residents by creating jobs," Mayor Richard Daley said in the release.
The new facility is expected to generate as many as 18 full-time jobs at CenterPoint and more than 1,000 jobs once future tenants set up shop.
